2608.12977.title: Beyond Handcrafted Security: Towards Self-Evolving Defense for LLM Agents
2608.12977.paper_summary: The expanding operational capabilities of large language model (LLM) agents introduce sophisticated security threats. Runtime defenses have emerged as an effective approach to mitigating these risks by integrating security mechanisms into the agent execution loop. However, existing runtime defenses rely heavily on manually designed interventions and lack a principled framework for their construction and maintenance. In this work, we first develop a harness-level formulation of runtime defense that systematically characterizes how harness mechanisms enable defense construction and provides a unified view of existing runtime defense interventions from a harness perspective. Building on this formulation, we propose HARD (Harness-based Autonomous Runtime Defense Evolution), a self-evolving runtime defense framework that automatically identifies appropriate intervention strategies and iteratively improves defense artifacts based on observed failure traces. HARD transforms runtime defense development from manual engineering into an autonomous evolution process, and extensive experiments demonstrate that it improves security performance over existing handcrafted defenses while preserving benign task utility. Our findings highlight autonomous defense evolution as a promising new paradigm for securing deployed LLM agents, enabling agents to identify defense weaknesses and continuously improve their protection mechanisms.
2608.12977.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型 (LLM) 代理的擴展運作能力引入了複雜的安全威脅。<lb/>執行時防禦已成為減輕這些風險的有效方法，通過將安全機制整合到代理執行循環中。<lb/>然而，現有的執行時防禦在很大程度上依賴於手動設計的干預措施，並且缺乏一個原則性的框架來構建和維護這些措施。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們首先開發了一種執行時防禦的鞍座級別表述，系統性地描述了鞍座機制如何促進防禦構建，並從鞍座的角度提供了現有執行時防禦干預的統一視圖。<lb/>基於這一表述，我們提出了HARD（基於鞍座的自動執行時防禦演進），這是一個自我演進的執行時防禦框架，能自動識別適當的干預策略，並根據觀察到的失敗痕跡迭代改進防禦工件。<lb/>HARD將執行時防禦的開發從手動工程轉變為一個自動演進過程，廣泛的實驗表明，它在提高安全性能的同時，保持了良性任務的效用，超越了現有的手工防禦。<lb/>我們的研究結果突顯了自動防禦演進作為一種有前景的新範式，用於保護部署的LLM代理，使代理能夠識別防禦弱點並持續改進其保護機制。
